name: b1-02-filled-pause-disfluency
description: Two disfluent mid-thought pauses inside one unfinished sentence — one after a filler ('um'), one after a comma — then the landing. Both score far below the completion threshold, so both extend the floor and neither closes the patience window. The second mechanism this bar depends on: a pause whose WORDS say 'still going'.

midThoughtPauses.note: discourse-marker pause — trailed off on a comma

landings.note: the thought resolves into a single finished claim

events.text: so the thing I've been chewing on is um
whether the retry logic is even,
